name: The Queen who adopted a Goblin
source: The Kingdom of Golden Kine has just won a great battle against a great horde of goblins. As the king proudly surveyed the aftermath of the battlefield with his beloved, they find a lone goblin survivor within one of the destroyed catapults. The Queen takes an interest in him and decides to adopt him in order to discover and learn how humans and goblins could peacefully co-exist. Thus her "discovery" begins and her son will be the witness..​.
translation: 金凯恩王国刚刚赢得了一场对抗大群哥布林的大战。当国王自豪地与他心爱的人一起审视战场的余波时，他们在一个被摧毁的弹射器中发现了一名孤独的妖精幸存者。女王对他感兴趣并决定收养他，以发现和了解人类和妖精如何和平共处。因此，她的“发现”开始了，她的儿子将成为见证人……​
